chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Joe Glaser opens the Sunset and bills Louis the World's Greatest Trumpeter
summary: Back in Chicago Zutty was doubling with Doc Cook while Joe Glaser opened the Sunset and first billed Louis Armstrong as World's Greatest Trumpeter.

bands.name: Doc Cook and His Seventeen Interns

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well one thing I just wanted to ask you, when you were back there in Chicago what were you doing then when Louis and Father Hines had the band at the Sunset?
Yes we were there, we were there. I was playing with, I think that was when I was with Cook.

Because we doubled, you know, we were doubling see, and in the mean time Joe Glaser opened the Sunset. And he was the first one to put Louis' name, 'World's Greatest Trumpeter'. He was the first one to hang that notice, to do that. Yes.
